newsitem.title: CHINA: China to develop steel, copper, ethylene plants.
newsitem.headline: China to develop steel, copper, ethylene plants.

text.p: China will speed up its efforts in steel production as well as copper and ethylene output after identifying key projects for development in 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
It quoted the State Planning Commission as saying key projects include the third phase of the Shanghai Baoshan Iron and Steel Co and a steel factory in southern Guangzhou.
It will also boost a copper factory in central Jiangxi province, an ethylene project of 300,000-tonne capacity in northeastern Jilin province and the Tianjin Zhenxing Cement Plant, it said.
It gave no more details of the projects.
